scope: 14 verified catalog SKUs, with model identity, photographic ambiguity and unverified cap details treated explicitly

sports.2099: Catalog model 2099 is a 550 ml sports-bottle reference with 7 by 19 cm dimensions and PP plus PC listed as its materials. Unlike many earlier sports products containing an ABS entry, this record identifies only those two polymer families; that difference does not prove which individual part uses each polymer. Color options are described as custom and require confirmation with sales rather than being presented as ready stock. A corporate buyer considering an entry-level capacity should request an exact-SKU photo and fully assembled sample, especially because nearby model 2100 is represented by the same gallery image in the current source. Compare the measured height, closure, branding position and materials of both items before treating them as interchangeable. The packaging type remains unconfirmed; 60 pieces and a 45 by 38 by 39 cm outer carton are catalog references.
sports.2100: Sports model 2100 offers 650 ml capacity and a source size of 7 by 21 cm, compared with 550 ml and 7 by 19 cm for nearby model 2099. Both are recorded with PP and PC materials and configurable colors rather than a fixed color range. The current catalog references the same photo for both models, so wholesale buyers should ask the factory for separate verified photographs and assembled samples before publishing model-specific visual claims. Examine the actual drinking opening, full body height and printed logo area; a different capacity alone does not guarantee identical accessories or tooling. This record leaves the exact bag packaging type for confirmation but lists 60 items per outer carton of 46 by 37 by 45 cm. Confirm packaging, polymer details and selected colors on the purchase order.
sports.2212: Model 2212 represents a 1,000 ml sports bottle with a source dimensional reference of 7.7 by 28.5 cm. Purple-pink, blue-orange, pink-blue and gray-black gradients are its listed designs, which differ from several similarly sized sports references. For a retailer preparing a multi-size sports collection, measure the physical assembled bottle and compare its final height against the 1,000 ml products cataloged at 29 cm; a half-centimeter difference should not be presented as guaranteed without a measured sample. The source mentions PC, PP and ABS but does not establish the shape of the drinking closure or leak performance. Individual OPP bags and 60 units per carton of 48 by 40 by 58.5 cm are listed. Obtain an exact-model color proof, lid photographs and packed-box verification before purchase.
sports.2400: Sports model 2400 is a smaller 380 ml bottle with catalog measurements of 6.6 by 17.5 cm. Its black-gray, blue-pink, pink-green-blue and green-orange gradients differ from the white, black, blue and cyan solid colors recorded for 2400---, although the source dimensions and 80-piece carton quantity match. For promotional sets with a compact product requirement, select the finished color on a physical sample and check whether the intended artwork remains legible over a changing background. PC, PP and ABS are recorded as component families, not as proof of a specific closure mechanism, compliance grade or leak-resistance rating. The catalog lists individual OPP bags and master cartons measuring 55 by 34 by 37 cm. Confirm sample identity, complete assembled height and packaging before ordering.
sports.2470: Sports bottle 2470 is listed at 800 ml with catalog dimensions of 7.5 by 7.5 by 24 cm. White, pink, cyan and blue are its recorded color options, providing a different merchandising palette from the black, pink, purple and translucent green choices shown for sports model 2406, despite the two having the same three-part dimensional reference. Buyers preparing a matched promotional assortment should inspect each actual assembled bottle before assuming the same lid or mold fits both models. The source lists PC, PP and ABS components without identifying resin grades for the drinking-contact parts or any sealing test. Individual OPP bags and 60 bottles per master carton of 50 by 49.5 by 49.5 cm are recorded. Confirm exact-SKU photographs, the printable surface and the packed configuration before quoting.
sports.5299: The 5299 sports bottle is cataloged at 550 ml with dimensions of 6.5 by 23 cm, presenting a different tall, narrow reference from the 7 by 19 cm model 2099 despite their shared nominal capacity. PP and PC are the recorded material families, while gradient colors are available only as a customization discussion subject to seller confirmation. A distributor sourcing private-label hydration gifts should request photos of the exact assembled SKU, confirm the printable panel and examine the real drinking closure rather than infer design from the catalog family. The source does not identify the exact unit bag type; it lists 60 pieces per shipping carton of 40 by 33.5 by 47 cm. Review body height, actual color proof, component grades and carton protection before preparing a landed-cost estimate.
sports.5340: Sports model 5340 is a 1,000 ml catalog bottle measuring 8 by 28 cm, offered with a white reference and other colors subject to custom-order confirmation. Its proportions differ from narrow 1,000 ml references listed at 7.7 by 29 cm, which may matter for shelf and packaging layout but should be checked on measured assembled samples. PP and PC appear in the material entry, with no confirmed ABS component or specific leakproof performance. The exact unit bag specification is not established by the catalog. For corporate branding, request an exact-product sample, a printable-area diagram and confirmation of any lid pieces before approving artwork. The recorded logistics are 60 units per master carton of 49 by 42 by 57 cm. Verify colors, final packed size and destination-market documentation.
sports.8563: Sports bottle 8563 is a 600 ml model with catalog dimensions of 6.8 by 26 cm and PP plus PC materials. Compared with shorter 550 ml models, its source measurements prompt a separate display-height and shipping-box review, not an unsupported claim about its drinking mechanism. The catalog offers gradient colors as a customization possibility, without a confirmed production palette or current inventory. Buyers planning a promotional run should request a physical bottle with its intended logo and verify that a chosen color transition does not reduce print legibility. The exact individual bag type remains to be confirmed with the supplier, although 60 units and a 42 by 35 by 53 cm master-carton reference are recorded. Check component materials, assembly, finished height and protection before approving bulk supply.
sports.2400---: Sports SKU 2400--- is a compact 380 ml catalog reference measuring 6.6 by 17.5 cm. Its recorded solid colors are white, black, blue and cyan, whereas model 2400 of the same capacity and dimensions lists blended gradient options. This distinction supports separate artwork and color approvals but does not establish different caps or body tooling. For an event-gift buyer working with smaller giveaway bottles, request the assembled sample to check total height, opening dimensions and the position of a small logo. PC, PP and ABS appear on the materials line without a component breakdown or safety certification for the finished item. The individual OPP bag and 80-piece master carton, measuring 55 by 34 by 37 cm, should be confirmed on the ordered variant before calculating packaging or freight.
sports.2401---: The 650 ml sports model 2401--- is a 6.6 by 22 cm catalog product supplied in white, black, blue and cyan solid-color references. It shares nominal measurements with gradient model 2401, so an importer must not claim a special lid or an additional feature based only on the distinct catalog code. Instead, evaluate whether the chosen plain background improves legibility of a printed brand and verify the exact factory sample identity. Materials are listed as PC, PP and ABS without assigning polymers to the bottle, lid and possible seal. The source gives individual OPP bags and 60 units in a 41.5 by 35 by 46 cm shipping carton. Check assembled height, printing position and packaging with the approved sample, especially when ordering both catalog variants.

jugs.6252: Jug model 6252 is a 1,800 ml catalog product with a listed 11.5 by 27.8 cm format and a white color reference. This solid-color selection contrasts with the many multi-gradient large jugs, making a separate branding proof important when presenting it as part of a wholesale gym range. The catalog names PC, PP and ABS as component families and does not identify a specific cap, carrying method or certified leakproof construction. Request the complete assembled product and verify the drinking opening, lid pieces and area suitable for private-label decoration. Individual OPP bags, rather than the frosted drawstring bags used by several other jugs, are recorded; the source lists 40 pieces in a 59 by 48 by 58 cm carton. Confirm production colors, protection and shipment measurements before approval.

The nearby 2306--- listing carries the same nominal size, material families, color set and carton measurements, so no separate lid or mold design should be asserted without exact factory evidence. Ask for SKU-labeled, assembled samples and compare the actual body, opening and detachable components before authorizing separate product photos. PC, PP and ABS appear on the source materials line, not as a certificate or component-by-component bill of materials. Mixed frosted drawstring-bag packaging and 40 units per 61 by 51 by 48.5 cm carton are listed. Confirm the transparent variant appearance, factory identity and protection before repeat orders.
jugs.2306---: Model 2306--- is a source-listed 1,600 ml water jug measuring 11.8 by 24 cm, with transparent black, red, green and blue variants. Its recorded size, PC/PP/ABS material list, drawstring-bag packaging and 40-piece carton all match those of model 2307---. It would be misleading to invent a different cap, handle or safety feature merely to make the listing unique. For wholesale customers requesting both factory codes, the first decision is whether distinct assemblies can be demonstrated by labeled samples and clear factory drawings. Request a separate exact-SKU photo set and document any confirmed differences before approving product-page specifications. The catalog shows mixed frosted drawstring bags in a 61 by 51 by 48.5 cm master carton. Verify quantities, colors and shipment protection on the actual order.
jugs.2308---: Water jug 2308--- is documented at 2,400 ml and 12.3 by 24 cm, compared with 1,600 ml entries 2306--- and 2307--- from the transparent-color series. Transparent black, red, green and blue are its catalog colors, while the material record states PC, PP and ABS without exact component assignments. A purchaser constructing a two-capacity jug assortment should compare assembled product height, actual filled weight and printing space rather than assume the same carrying parts. Source packing is mixed frosted drawstring bags and 40 pieces per master carton measuring 72.5 by 58.5 by 55 cm, a different carton from the 1,600 ml variants. Obtain SKU-specific lid photographs, a color proof and a confirmed packed sample before quoting transport or claiming leak resistance.
